regions.label: Rain-streaked window
regions.observation: The rain had been working the glass harder than I had worked a case.

regions.label: Desk
regions.observation: Three old cases, two unpaid bills, one clean page.

regions.label: Telephone
regions.observation: Quiet. For once it had the decency to look guilty.

regions.label: Case files
regions.observation: Closed, abandoned, and one I still lied about.

regions.label: Office door
regions.observation: The hall smelled worse, but at least it led somewhere.
